SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.title: Relic Exchange
SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.MENU.descr:
You enter a smoke-filled hut.
Behind the counter, a mysterious merchant smiles at you:
"Welcome! Take your pick — I've got plenty to trade."
SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.MENU.optio: Choose a relic to give up, then pick one from the selection.
Choose a relic to give up, then enchant a card of your choice.
Lose [red]5[/red] HP and refresh the relic and enchantment selection.
SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.SELECT_LOS: Which relic will you give up?
SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.CLOSE.desc: The merchant waves goodbye: "Come back anytime!"
